event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Product was distributed in Utah, Virginia, Texas, and California. Mostly distributed to restaurants, one distributor in Houston, Texas, one retail store in Orange County in Southern California.
